name: io.github.eandualem/xstate-mcp
title: XState MCP
description: MCP server bridging XState v5 inspection API to AI coding agents

environmentVariables.name: XSTATE_MCP_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: WebSocket server port for receiving XState inspection events

environmentVariables.name: XSTATE_MCP_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: WebSocket server bind address (localhost only by default)

environmentVariables.name: XSTATE_MCP_BUFFER_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Max events per actor in ring buffer

environmentVariables.name: XSTATE_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed WebSocket origins (supports * port wildcard)

environmentVariables.name: XSTATE_MCP_REQUIRE_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: When true, reject WebSocket connections without an Origin header
